Cc: finance@silverpine.com
Date: 2028-05-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Silverpine vendor enrollment - bank info & forms

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks for kicking off the onboarding. Attached are the signed W-9 and a bank letter from our bank (Santander) showing account ownership. Below are the bank details in the format your vendor portal requested:

- Bank name: Santander Bank NA
- Account name: Silverpine Logistics LLC
- Account type: Checking
- Routing (ABA): 011000138
- Account: 784512309
- SWIFT/BIC: SVRNUS33

We haven’t received the micro-deposit from Redwood yet — let us know the expected amounts/format so we can confirm when they hit. Also, we need to confirm the PO mapping: our billing system requires the PO number to be placed in the "Remittance Reference" field on payments.

Attachments: W9_Silverpine.pdf, Silverpine_BankLetter.pdf

Open to a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Dir. of Finance
Silverpine Logistics
anna.lopez@silverpine.com
(415) 555-0198

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-21T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Silverpine vendor enrollment - bank info & forms

Hi Anna — thanks for the docs. A few quick items so we can finish enrollment on our side: 

1) Micro-deposit check: finance will send two small micro-deposits (range $0.05–$0.99). We will send amounts and expected arrival window below once the payments are kicked off (should appear within 1–2 business days). Please confirm the account name exactly matches your bank letter (it does from what I see).

2) Remittance reference: we can include PO number in the Remittance Reference field. Please confirm the exact field name your AP system will parse (e.g., "Remittance Reference", "Invoice Notes", or a custom tag).

3) Invoice/PO mapping: what is the preferred invoice header (Bill To / Ship To) and the first PO you expect to invoice against? If you can send a sample invoice pdf, that’ll speed validation.

4) Attachments: I’ve forwarded your files to Payments Ops (jonas) to prepare the micro-deposit. We require a bank letter + W-9 for ACH; thanks for including both.

Next steps: Jonas will confirm the micro-deposit amounts after they process. Once we confirm micro-deposit match, we will assign PO-99021 in our system and notify you of the remit reference format we will populate.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, finance@silverpine.com
Date: 2028-05-21T14:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Silverpine vendor enrollment - bank info & forms

Mina — thanks for the quick reply. We confirmed that the account name on the bank letter is exactly "Silverpine Logistics LLC" (same as our ACH setup). I attached a sample remittance CSV that our AR team consumes (SP_Remittance_Sample.csv). The expected invoice header should include: Invoice#, PO#, Invoice Date, Net Amount, Remittance Reference.

We will monitor for micro-deposits and confirm on our side as soon as they post.

Attachments: SP_Remittance_Sample.csv
